author: yummys
body:
Age: 15 turning 16 in December

Timezone: UTC-07:00

Do you have Teamspeak? Yes

Do you have Discord? Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? No I do not have any experience as a moderator on any other server, because like most people the only staff related thing I have done is be a mod on a very tiny server of around 7 people, so that doesn't really count. 


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating? My biggest weakness is probably being kind to people I dislike, It will not really affect my moderating, because I don't dislike anyone on avicus. I enjoy talking to everyone and helping them out if needed.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not? Some qualities I think a leader should have are; being kind to everyone, have good listening skills, be able to express his/her opinion without being afraid of what others might think, and last of all spending time with his members/followers. I would consider myself a leader, but not a great leader, but I could work on it more, and become an even better leader. This is because as I have said before I need to work on being kind to everyone, but other than that everything's good.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? Some attributes that distinguish me from other players that would qualify me to be a moderator are; I enjoy spending large amounts of time on avicus, so I can get to know everyone. I also interact with the community, not just to help them, but to talk to them, and share some laughs. I also am very respectful to everyone, even if they are being rude.

 

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? Some skills I think one should have when interacting with the community are; being a good listener, so you can hear what you have to say and not dominate the entire conversation. Another one is being socially healthy, so you are not awkward and people like you. I do believe I have these skills, because I try to strengthen them daily. 


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating? The three main character traits I think a moderator should have when moderating are; 1. respecting everyone 2. thinking before they speak, so they don't blurt out inappropriate stuff 3. loving everyone. These are because a moderator should be a good person overall, because their job is too look over the server to make sure nothing against the rules happens in the community.



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do? You should first ask the moderator to please gather more evidence, and to take his/her job a little more seriously, and then you should report it to a Senior Moderator, and Admin.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? Even thought that is allowed, I would tell the players to please stop talking bad about other people, and that it is very disrespectful to talk behind people's backs, because they wouldn't like it if someone was talking bad about them. 



You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? I would talk to the staff member, and tell him/her that he/she should know better than to share information not allowed to the public, and ask him/her to not do it again, then I would take a screenshot of the post he/she posted, then I would send it to a senior moderator, and adim.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do? I would ask them to please stop what they are doing, because they are abusing their power. Then I would record them doing those things, and send it to an admin.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator? I want to be a moderator, because it is something I have wanted since I first joined this server around 2-3 years ago. I really want to be a moderator, because I enjoy playing on here and really like spending time with the players on avicus. I also enjoy keeping the server rule-breaker free, and a fun, fair environment for everyone. 


What does Avicus mean to you? Avicus means a lot to me, I have made very good friends, and been on many great teams. Avicus is really important to me, because I spend most of my time on this server, and like talking/helping everyone that enjoys it as much as me. 


Anything specific the staff team could do better? Some things I think the staff team could do better is, ask all of their staff members to be more active, but other than that I think the staff team is doing really great, and can continue to be great for a long time. 


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus? I chose to apply at Avicus, because it is the only server I play on as much as I do. Also it's been my dream to be a staff member on this server since I first joined. I also chose to apply here because it is the best community I have ever been a part of and really enjoy it a lot.


Do you have anything else to add to your application? I would like to add that even thought I have weaknesses like every human being, I think if you gave me this opportunity to be a staff member on this wonderful community, I could really work on my weaknesses, and strengthen my strenghts even more, to become a great staff member, and look over this server.



                                                                                                                                                             Dear,

                                                                                                                                                             Aaron
